activities.summary: Appeared as a new entry in the DFSA public register of authorised firms (DIFC). Licence F007833, Dealing in Investments as Agent (Authorised Firms). Removed a corrupted telephone value left by a parser bug. The DFSA page renders label/value pairs, and a firm with no telephone collapses so that the next label sits where the number should be. These records had been counting as reachable when they are not.
